name: San Juan
summary: Card game adaptation of Puerto Rico where players build buildings to produce and trade goods for cards and victory points.
rules_text: Shuffle building cards; each player starts with an Indigo Plant building and 4 cards in hand. 5 role tiles are in the center. Each round the governor chooses an unchosen role, taking its privilege, then all players in clockwise order execute the role action. Next player chooses another role, etc., until roles are exhausted. Roles: Builder - may build one building from hand paying cost in discarded cards, builder gets -1 cost; Producer - place a face-down card from deck as a good on an empty production building, producer may produce a second; Trader - reveal top trade tile setting prices, each player may sell one good for that many cards from deck, trader may sell a second; Councillor - draw 2 keep 1, councillor draws 5 keep 1; Prospector - draw 1 card. Violet buildings give special powers. Game ends when a player has 12 buildings; highest VP from buildings wins.
rating_reason: San Juan is card role game with hidden hands, trading, pure strategy.
